html: צדק (√ of foll.; NH, Aramaic in deriv.; cf. Arabic صَدَقَ speak the truth (also صَدْقٌ hard, even, straight, perfect); Sab. צדק just, epith. of king Mordtm ZMG xxx (1876), 37 HomChrest. 125; usually excellent DHM ZMG xxix (1875), 595, 599 CIS iv. p. 176; also verb favour, endow (one with something) CIS iv. No. 198, 1. 4 DHM l.c. MordtmHim. Inschr. 70 f.; Ph. צדק adj. just, right, TelAm (Can.) ṣaduḳ innocent; Old Aramaic צדק n. righteousness, loyalty, Nab. אצדק adj. authorized, Palm. זדקתא εὐσεβής; Saho sadaḳ, be true, clear Reinisch Saho Spr, (1890) 312; Ethiopic ጸድቀ: be just, righteous, so NH צדק Pi. Hiph., Aramaic צְדֵיק, ܙܕܰܩ; cf. Kau Deriv. d. St. צדק (1881) HPSצדק etc. Presb. Rev., 1882, 165 ff. Gerber 206 ff.).
